description: MainActivity.kt defines the primary Android activity for the app, handling user interface setup, calculator logic, voice search integration, and history panel management within a calculator app.
external_files: R.id.* (various resource IDs for layout views and buttons)

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing the calculator UI, voice search, and history functionalities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity UI, initializes voice search, and binds keypad and history panel.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the display with the current expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates the result display, also saving to history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Binds calculator keypad buttons to input symbols and evaluates expressions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Initializes the event handlers for showing/hiding the history drawer.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Displays the calculator history in a sliding drawer with animation.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides the history drawer with animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Fills the history drawer UI with stored calculation entries.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history display if the drawer is currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles theme toggle menu item selection.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity results, primarily for voice input, delegating to voiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission responses, delegating to voiceSearchBar.
